question: Does comparing both accepted causal siblings at equal depth improve completed-track quality over the promoted runner-up-only tournament?

intervention.rule: At an otherwise unchanged admitted regret event, independently advance every live causal sibling to the interrupted gap. Stably rank the interrupted prefix and each successful probe by authored-prefix axis loss, schedule the lowest-loss prefix first, and retain every other prefix and every generated side branch as ordinary frontier work.
unchanged: ordinary DFS outside the bounded tournament

edge_semantics.probe_dead_end_or_deferred: Record the individual probe outcome and continue with remaining siblings.
edge_semantics.execution_ceiling: Stop the tournament, retain every materialized prefix, and obey the existing compile ceiling.
edge_semantics.ties: Current prefix wins an exact tie; otherwise lower authored-axis loss wins, with original sibling rank as the stable tie-break.
edge_semantics.nested_selective_backtracking: Disabled inside each bounded probe, exactly as in production.

telemetry.compatibility: Existing probe frame/node fields become exact sums over probe_results. Production has one result and retains its prior numerical meaning. Offline binary checkpoint rules explicitly exclude multi-sibling tournaments.

predeclared_screen.automatic_controls: Benchmark V2 back-fills one source in every otherwise empty stratum; controls are expected to remain unchanged unless the mechanism fires.
predeclared_screen.decision: Advance only if all cells retain validity, the target-source score sum is positive, and positive direction is supported by more than one changed target cell. This focused screen cannot authorize promotion or a canonical headline run by itself.

focused_screen_result.telemetry_integrity: The analyzer validates per-event ordinal uniqueness, aggregate frame/node sums, best-alternative loss, selected ordinal, checkpoint bounds, and every compile-level probe counter. All checks pass.
focused_screen_result.interpretation: The focused result clears its gate without a validity confound. The second sibling wins 13 tournaments, and the arm converts greater pre-completion search into positive completed-track quality on every seed block. The amplitude variant remains heterogeneous, so this is promising rather than promotable.

predeclared_full_catalog_screen.decision: Continue to an independent larger confirmation only if all cells retain validity, the full-catalog score sum is positive, and positive movement is not confined to one isolated cell. This N2 breadth screen cannot authorize canonical evaluation or promotion.

full_catalog_screen_result.interpretation: The breadth gate passes narrowly and without a validity confound. Direction is nearly neutral over all 44 sources at N2, but movement extends to a fresh high-air case and the pooled believer evidence remains positive. This justifies a fresh targeted confirmation, not canonical evaluation.

predeclared_fresh_confirmation.automatic_controls: Benchmark V2 back-fills capability and legacy-regression controls.
predeclared_fresh_confirmation.decision: A canonical N48 evaluation is justified only if every cell retains validity, the fresh target-source score sum is positive, at least ten of sixteen target seed blocks are positive, and positive target movement is not confined to one cell. The canonical evaluator remains the only promotion authority.

non_claim: This evaluates the first full-depth, all-live-sibling tournament at 750k. A negative result would not reject multi-sibling or voluntary-backtracking strategies with different probe allocation, stopping, or selection rules.
